gaps.label: Local Housing Allowance
gaps.detail: Modelled gainers and gains fall well short of 1.15m × £1,480; uniform Annex A scaling halves the rise.

gaps.label: Threshold freeze
gaps.reason: 2031 income path in the new data
gaps.detail: Against the tax-year liability; the income tax leg is £4.5bn against £3.0bn.

gaps.label: Employer NI threshold
gaps.detail: Against the net post-behavioural figure; full pay pass-through and no corporation tax in the model. Drill 4 under-23s: more 21–22 employments in the data.
